demo.label: Client demo
demo.summary: A site built to show a client. Hidden from search, sample-content badges, no analytics, deployed by hand. Promote it with go-live.

marketing.label: Production marketing site
marketing.summary: A public site that search should find: SEO, sitemap, built-site checks, browser tests, CI and Git deploys.

content.label: Content or docs site
content.summary: A marketing site plus a Markdown collection for posts or docs.

app.label: App
app.summary: Screens people work in, hidden from search. Optional Worker API and D1 database.

scratch.label: Scratch
scratch.summary: A test bed for an idea (web audio, a library). Dev, build and format only. No CI, no tests, no agent docs beyond CLAUDE.local.md.
